pointcast.label: PointCast blockchain
pointcast.note: PointCast's verified marketplace runs on Tezos. A separate PointCast blockchain has not been identified; network details are needed before a second-chain mint can be prepared.

disclosure: Preview only. Planned artwork price: 1 tez. Purchase, minting and listing are unavailable. Network fees are additional and currently unknown; the signing wallet must show its estimate. No tokens, stock, ownership or completed sales are asserted.
